A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] spice-mining [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]. The course opened in a large set of grandstands and remained that way until the course broke off into the mining fields. From there competitors would encounter soft turns and several straightaways. The course also passed by numerous mining vehicles left around the course, some which served as obstacles. The [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]] favored this course, and would challenge opponents on it.<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''. It is one of five courses available at the start of the game.<ref name="EiR" />
